items.title: Final: Sparks 89, Lynx 82. What a damn gutsy win. Los Angeles snaps Minnesota’s 10-game winning streak. It is just the 2nd win by the Sparks over the Lynx in the last 16 meetings, and the 3rd in the last 22. Might be the most all-around impactful game of Cameron Brink’s career.
